details: Bitcoin (BTC) breached $86,000 on Friday, and Ethereum (ETH) climbed back above $2,700, extending gains amidst improved market sentiment. This rally follows weaker-than-expected U.S. payrolls data and dovish comments from the Federal Reserve, which eased fears of an imminent interest-rate hike. Citigroup has significantly raised its 12-month Bitcoin price target to $113,000 from $82,000, and its Ethereum target to $3,028 from $2,240. The bank cited stronger cryptocurrency activity, more favorable macroeconomic conditions, and renewed inflows into exchange-traded funds as reasons for the upgrades. Bitcoin's year-to-date performance shows a 3% decline, while Ethereum is down about 9%.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $86,000, Ethereum Reclaims $2,700 as Citi Raises Price Targets

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has proposed a new regulatory framework to govern how investment advisers and regulated funds custody cryptocurrency. The initiative aims to establish updated standards for safeguarding digital assets, addressing unique risks, and providing clearer compliance guidelines for institutional market participants. This move could bring more clarity and security to institutional crypto holdings.
title: SEC Proposes New Crypto Custody Framework for Investment Advisers

details: Solana is experiencing significant activity with its Alpenglow consensus upgrade now live on testnet, aiming to reduce transaction finality to approximately 150 milliseconds. Financial technology giant Fiserv has launched Roughrider Coin, a dollar-backed token for interbank settlements on Solana, benefiting over 90 North Dakota banks. Additionally, Shinhan Bank, South Korea's second-largest commercial bank, has completed a successful pilot for stablecoin-based corporate overseas remittances using Solana's blockchain.
title: Solana Ecosystem Sees Major Developments: Alpenglow Testnet, Fiserv, Shinhan Bank Pilots

details: While Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, and Solana all posted gains, Dogecoin (DOGE) fell by approximately 4.7% to around $0.095. Dogecoin's 22% gain over the last 90 days significantly trailed its major rivals, which saw returns between 31% and 53%. This underperformance is attributed to a structural problem: Dogecoin adds 5 billion new coins yearly without a supply cap, requiring buyers to absorb a substantial amount of fresh supply daily.
title: Dogecoin Lags Behind Major Cryptos Despite Broader Market Recovery

details: Illinois has agreed to postpone its controversial 0.2% cryptocurrency transaction tax by six months, pushing the implementation to July 1, 2027, pending court approval. This delay provides relief to crypto businesses and investors in the state.

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has approved another $139 million payout to El Salvador. details: South African bank Absa Group has launched digital-asset custody services on the XRP Ledger. The bank has secured regulatory approval to offer institutional custody, administration, and transfers for Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), XRP, and USDC, marking a significant step for institutional adoption in the region.
